categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in integrated waste treatment including industrial waste incineration and power generation, mercury-containing waste recycling, pyrolysis treatment for precious metals recovery, waste printed circuit board (PCB) copper recycling, and environmental remediation engineering. It provides comprehensive resource recycling and green energy solutions, transforming waste into useful resources while minimizing environmental impact.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Key technologies include incineration, solidification, chemical treatment, washing, pyrolysis, dry and wet crushing, water shaking table separation, and metallurgical processes such as acid leaching, electrolysis, and smelting to achieve high-purity copper recovery. The company also employs advanced pollution control systems like continuous emission monitoring (CEMS), carbon capture from flue gas, and fly ash washing for environmental compliance and resource recovery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse customer base including electronics manufacturers, chemical industries, construction, hospitality, and government agencies. Its major markets are domestic Taiwan with significant sales to industrial clients and government projects, and overseas sales primarily to Japan focusing on recycled copper products.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly based in Taiwan with facilities located in Taoyuan and other industrial parks. Overseas sales focus on the Japanese market. The company is also expanding international cooperation, including partnerships with Japanese refining companies, to build a global circular economy network.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the waste management and recycling supply chain, handling waste collection, treatment, resource recovery, and environmental remediation. It acts as a key processor converting waste materials into reusable resources and energy.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing resource recycling efficiency, developing high-value recycling technologies, expanding environmental remediation services, and innovating green products. R&D focuses on improving pyrolysis and metallurgical processes, carbon capture and reuse, fly ash detoxification, and recycling of emerging waste streams like lithium batteries and solar panels. Collaboration with research institutes and universities supports technology advancement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees for waste treatment and environmental remediation, sales of recycled materials such as copper powder, and government contracts. The company also benefits from subsidies and incentives related to environmental compliance and circular economy initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in Taiwan's industrial waste treatment and resource recycling market, especially in hazardous waste incineration and PCB copper recovery. It competes with other licensed waste treatment firms but differentiates through integrated treatment capabilities, advanced technology, and comprehensive environmental solutions. Market share in waste lighting recycling is about 59%, and PCB recycling about 22%.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company has shown steady growth with 2024 consolidated revenue reaching approximately NT$1.72 billion, a 35% increase over the previous year, and net profit rising 61%. It completed a successful IPO in September 2024, strengthening its capital base. Total assets increased by 13.7%, and equity grew by over 52%, reflecting robust financial health and expansion capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive, high-efficiency waste treatment solutions that integrate multiple technologies to achieve zero waste and zero emissions goals. It offers high-purity recycled materials, advanced environmental remediation services, and innovative green technologies. Its strong regulatory compliance, certified facilities, and professional team provide customers with reliable, sustainable, and value-added waste management services.
